content:
A leaker who previously spotted iPhone Duo features in Apple code has now found similar clues in HomePad. The upcoming device shares one feature in common with Apple's foldable iPhone during the setup process.

The leaker noted that the setup process will take place in the Home app, and shared three screenshots of the setup process…

iPhone Duo StandBy mode

Apple's StandBy mode offers several options that turn your iPhone into a useful information display while charging. Leaker pdfu previously shared five unreleased StandBy interfaces for the iPhone Duo found in the device's Xcode simulator.

  • Home Camera
  • Home Modular
  • Flow
  • Fade
  • Snoopy

HomePad setup screen

One of the on-screen options for StandBy mode is Photo Face, which pdfu says will also be available on the HomePad.

They explained that the setup process will have the device capture a few high-resolution photos for you to choose from immediately, while your full photo library will be downloaded from iCloud.

We expect Apple's smart home hub to launch on October 13, with a design based on the iMac G4. You can read more about the rumored design here.
